<!-- Title: feat(scope): summary, fix(scope): summary, docs: summary, or feat!: breaking summary. The PR title becomes the squash commit subject. Shipped chart/image/runtime fixes should use fix or feat. -->

## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.
For a breaking change, explain the migration path here and mark the title with `!`.

## Validation

List checks run, including upstream/Kubernetes live checks where relevant.
Call out any acceptance criteria that remain unverified.

## Compatibility and storage

For protocol or lifecycle changes: explain client compatibility, retry behavior,
credential impact, and whether retained state or schema migration is affected.
